title: Voxy Server Side Backport
description: Render distant Voxy LODs on servers, backported to 1.21.1 fabric
body:
# VSS-backport

VSS-backport is based on https://modrinth.com/plugin/voxy-server-side with minor changes to allow for 1.21.1 support

VSS-backport allows servers to share Voxy chunks between clients that have the voxy mod installed, so players dont need to explore to see distant chunks

## Setup Guide

### Client

- Install Voxy and voxy-server-side-fabric.jar in the mods/ directory.
- Config will be created at config/vss-client-config.json.

### Fabric Server

- Place voxy-server-side-fabric.jar into the mods/ folder on the server.
- Restart to apply the changes.
- Config will be created at config/vss-server-config.json.


please give all credit to the original developer of voxy server side :)
